BiblicalUsage: Bereaved is the state of a mother robbed of her young, and Scripture uses the bear for it. God says He will meet His people as a bear bereaved of her whelps, the proverb says a bear robbed of her whelps is safer to meet than a fool in his folly, and Hushai warns that David's mighty men are chafed in their minds as a bear robbed of her whelps.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God knows the fierceness of a bereaved mother, and He uses it to say how fierce His own judgment can be.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
